notes_for_editor: Only three readable sources, and two of them (FFLOS, firelookout.com) repeat the same 1931/1939 facts from the Kresek inventory; willhiteweb.com cites that inventory second-hand. The exact position of the lookout is unsettled (at the pass vs a ridge above it); the story says so. No staffing, fire name, or present-day site source found; the WebSearch returned no other page specific to this lookout. The WashingtonLookouts weebly page only lists it with a legal location (38N-18E-32), not used. Access level omitted: no source describes access.
